gen-zen-dots-gf-noto-sans-hatran: Noto Sans Hatran reads friendly and unfussy, with an e whose wide mouth funnels the eye in; Zen Dots stays generous with its space. Bump the body up a notch if it feels slight.
gen-zen-dots-gf-noto-sans-inscriptional-: Zen Dots splashes out with techy, friendly display shapes, each one given plenty of space to breathe. Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi keeps even its tiny counters unclogged, and that clarity is what the pair does best.
gen-zen-dots-gf-noto-sans-javanese: Zen Dots brings a friendly, techy swagger up front. Noto Sans Javanese follows with apertures that keep every counter linked to the space outside, so the text feels clean and uncluttered beside such a roomy heading.
gen-zen-dots-gf-noto-sans-kawi: Noto Sans Kawi reads clean, its c gaping like pliers. Shrink the Zen Dots heading too far and its generous spacing loses its punch, so let it stay large.
gen-zen-dots-gf-noto-sans-linear-b: Noto Sans Linear B reads modern and smooth, the eye gliding around each bend without a snag. And Zen Dots, with generous openings at every weight, carries that ease into a longer read.
gen-zen-dots-gf-noto-sans-manichaean: Noto Sans Manichaean reads modern and tidy, with e crossbars that leave their mouths open instead of pinching shut beside the heading. Zen Dots keeps that ease going over pages of text.
gen-zen-dots-gf-noto-sans-mongolian: Zen Dots leads with a techy, friendly display voice, every letter given generous room to stretch out and be seen. Noto Sans Mongolian adds flared terminals underneath, and that gentle outward kick is the pair's best trait.
gen-zen-dots-gf-noto-sans-nko: Zen Dots is techy and friendly, with generous openings at every weight. Noto Sans NKo backs it up with c openings you can see through, so heading and text both feel contemporary and light.
gen-zen-dots-gf-noto-sans-nko-unjoined: Noto Sans NKo Unjoined reads approachable and clear, giving small letters wide openings. And Zen Dots above it is just as spacious, so a slightly larger body size would suit them both.
gen-zen-dots-gf-noto-sans-old-south-arab: Soft, curvy and clean: Noto Sans Old South Arabian lets its strokes end before they turn inward, while Zen Dots brings a techy, friendly heading. Nudge the body size up a bit.
